+"""Strict original-defect reproduction audit; never feature or card admission."""
+from pathlib import Path
+from collections import Counter
+import json,re,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+P=json.loads((Path(__file__).parent/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text())
+def verify(folder):
+    folder=Path(folder)
+    assert int((folder/'exit.txt').read_text())!=0
+    log=(folder/'output.log').read_text()
+    assert 'BUILD FAILED' in log
+    assert not re.search(r'^e: |Compilation error|Unresolved reference',log,re.M)
+    assert re.findall(r'^> Task (\S+) FAILED$',log,re.M)==[':rules-engine:test']
+    files=list((folder/'junit').rglob('TEST-*.xml'))
+    assert len(files)==1
+    assert str(files[0].relative_to(folder/'junit'))=='rules-engine/build/test-results/test/TEST-'+P['class']+'.xml'
+    root=ET.fromstring(files[0].read_bytes());rows=root.findall('testcase')
+    assert root.get('name')==P['class']
+    assert [int(root.get(k)) for k in ['tests','failures','errors','skipped']]==[5,2,0,0]
+    assert Counter((t.get('classname'),t.get('name')) for t in rows)==Counter((P['class'],x) for x in P['cases'])
+    failures=[]
+    for row in rows:
+        name=row.get('name');f=row.find('failure')
+        assert row.find('error') is None and row.find('skipped') is None
+        if name in P['witnesses']:
+            assert f is not None and len(row.findall('failure'))==1
+            assert f.get('type')=='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError'
+            expected='expected:<"{R}"> but was:<"{3}{R}">'
+            assert expected in f.get('message','') and expected in (f.text or '')
+            frames=re.findall(r'BoltBendCostPredicateTest\.kt:(\d+)',f.text or '')
+            assert frames and int(frames[0])==P['witnesses'][name]
+            failures.append({'name':name,'line':int(frames[0]),'type':f.get('type'),'message':f.get('message')})
+        else:assert f is None
+    return {'state':'ORIGINAL_DEFECT_REPRODUCED_RECEIVING_PENDING','rows':5,'assertion_failures':failures,'passing_controls':3,'skips':0,'feature_admitted':False,'card_admitted':False}

+"""Synthetic auditor rejection checks; these are not engine behavioral evidence."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile,copy,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,json
+from audit import P,verify
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+    folder=Path(tmp);(folder/'exit.txt').write_text('1\n')
+    (folder/'output.log').write_text('> Task :rules-engine:test FAILED\nBUILD FAILED\n')
+    path=folder/'junit/rules-engine/build/test-results/test'/('TEST-'+P['class']+'.xml');path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    root=ET.Element('testsuite',name=P['class'],tests='5',failures='2',errors='0',skipped='0')
+    for name in P['cases']:
+        t=ET.SubElement(root,'testcase',name=name,classname=P['class'])
+        if name in P['witnesses']:
+            msg='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError: expected:<"{R}"> but was:<"{3}{R}">'
+            ET.SubElement(t,'failure',type='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError',message=msg).text=msg+'\n at fixture(BoltBendCostPredicateTest.kt:'+str(P['witnesses'][name])+')'
+    def write(r):path.write_bytes(ET.tostring(r))
+    write(root);verify(folder);rejected=[]
+    def reject(label,mutate):
+        r=copy.deepcopy(root);mutate(r);write(r)
+        try:verify(folder)
+        except (AssertionError,ValueError):rejected.append(label)
+        else:raise AssertionError('Accepted invalid report: '+label)
+    reject('missing-case',lambda r:r.remove(r[0]))
+    reject('duplicate-case',lambda r:r.append(copy.deepcopy(r[0])))
+    reject('wrong-class',lambda r:r[0].set('classname','wrong'))
+    reject('skip',lambda r:ET.SubElement(r[0],'skipped'))
+    reject('unrelated-failure',lambda r:ET.SubElement(r[0],'failure'))
+    reject('wrong-type',lambda r:r[2].find('failure').set('type','CompilationException'))
+    reject('wrong-message',lambda r:r[2].find('failure').set('message','expected other'))
+    reject('wrong-frame',lambda r:setattr(r[2].find('failure'),'text','expected:<"{R}"> but was:<"{3}{R}">\n at fixture(BoltBendCostPredicateTest.kt:1)'))
+    reject('missing-witness',lambda r:r[2].remove(r[2].find('failure')))
+    reject('wrong-count',lambda r:r.set('tests','4'))
+    write(root);(folder/'output.log').write_text('> Task :rules-engine:compileTestKotlin FAILED\nBUILD FAILED\n')
+    try:verify(folder)
+    except AssertionError:rejected.append('compiler-failure')
+    else:raise AssertionError('Accepted compilation failure')
+    print(json.dumps({'synthetic_rejections':rejected,'count':len(rejected)}))

+"""Compile and observe unchanged production; preserve original reports and bytes."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import os,json,subprocess,hashlib,re,traceback
+from audit import P,verify
+ROOT=Path.cwd();HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/P['evidence']
+sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True).strip()
+def save(p,b):p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b)
+def js(p,v):save(p,(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
+def bind(label):
+    source=os.environ['SOURCE'];assert git('rev-parse',source+'^{tree}')==os.environ['SOURCE_TREE']
+    assert git('rev-parse',source+'^')==P['base'] and git('rev-parse','HEAD^')==source
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',source,'HEAD')==os.environ['WORKFLOW']
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',P['base'],source).splitlines()==sorted(P['source_delta'])
+    assert git('rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main')==P['main']
+    assert not git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no')
+    trees={}
+    for path in P['unchanged_trees']:
+        before=git('rev-parse',P['base']+':'+path);after=git('rev-parse',source+':'+path)
+        assert before==after,path;trees[path]=after
+    js(OUT/label/'UNCHANGED_TREES.json',trees)
+    for path,digest in P['bindings'].items():
+        b=(ROOT/path).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==digest,path;save(OUT/label/'source'/path,b)
+    for path,digest in P['git_bindings'].items():
+        assert git('hash-object',path)==digest,path;save(OUT/label/'source'/path,(ROOT/path).read_bytes())
+    save(OUT/label/'TRACKED.diff',subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--']))
+    if label=='initial':
+        for f in HERE.iterdir():
+            if f.is_file():save(OUT/'protocol'/f.name,f.read_bytes())
+        save(OUT/'WORKFLOW.yml',(ROOT/os.environ['WORKFLOW']).read_bytes())
+        b=dict(source=source,tree=os.environ['SOURCE_TREE'],validation=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),validation_tree=git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),workflow=os.environ['WORKFLOW'],workflow_blob=git('hash-object',os.environ['WORKFLOW']),run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],attempt=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']),run_number=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER']))
+        assert b['attempt']==b['run_number']==1;js(OUT/'BINDING.json',b)
+def stage(name):
+    folder=OUT/name;folder.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for f in ROOT.glob('**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml'):
+        if OUT not in f.parents:f.unlink()
+    with (folder/'output.log').open('wb') as log:
+        rc=subprocess.run(['just','--working-directory',str(ROOT),'--justfile',str(HERE/'validation.just'),name],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ['KOTEST_INCLUDE_PATTERN','UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS']}).returncode
+    (folder/'exit.txt').write_text(str(rc)+'\n')
+    for f in ROOT.glob('**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml'):
+        if OUT not in f.parents:save(folder/'junit'/f.relative_to(ROOT),f.read_bytes())
+    if name=='compile':
+        log=(folder/'output.log').read_text();assert rc==0 and 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in log
+        assert not re.search(r'^e: |Compilation error|Unresolved reference|^> Task .* FAILED$',log,re.M)
+        assert not list((folder/'junit').rglob('TEST-*.xml'))
+    else:js(folder/'SUMMARY.json',verify(folder))
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir();bind('initial')
+    subprocess.run(['python3',str(HERE/'check_audit.py')],check=True)
+    stage('compile');stage('reproduce');bind('final')
+    js(OUT/'RESULT.json',{'state':'ORIGINAL_DEFECT_REPRODUCED_RECEIVING_PENDING','feature_admitted':False,'card_admitted':False})
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    try:main()
+    except Exception:
+        OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(OUT/'FAILURE.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc());raise
+    finally:
+        try:bind('final')
+        finally:
+            OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+            js(OUT/'MANIFEST.json',{str(f.relative_to(OUT)):sha(f.read_bytes()) for f in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and f.name!='MANIFEST.json'})

+name: Manual Bolt Bend original cost reproduction R1
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [validation/manual-bolt-bend-original-r1-20261030]
+    paths: ['.github/workflows/manual-bolt-bend-original-r1-20261030.yml']
+permissions: {contents: read}
+concurrency:
+  group: manual-transmission-engine-qualification
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+env:
+  SOURCE: b316dbd060c4cf41afa3bd756e47f281c079f78c
+  SOURCE_TREE: e2e3600c79adbdd9c6071822784420fde92ad024
+  WORKFLOW: .github/workflows/manual-bolt-bend-original-r1-20261030.yml
+  RECORD: experiments/manual-transmission/research/bolt-bend-original-reproduction-r1-20261030
+  GRADLE_OPTS: -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false
+  GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    if: github.run_number == 1 && github.run_attempt == 1
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with: {distribution: temurin, java-version: '21'}
+      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: '22', cache: npm, cache-dependency-path: web-client/package-lock.json}
+      - name: Install approved locked recipe runner
+        run: |
+          sudo apt-get update
+          sudo apt-get install -y just
+          command -v flock
+          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/argentum"
+      - name: Compile unchanged production then reproduce original cost defect
+        run: flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" python3 "$RECORD/run.py"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: manual-bolt-bend-original-r1-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: manual-bolt-bend-original-r1-evidence/
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
